title: Rockefeller Foundation global cooperation survey: security and opportunity in a stormy world
discussion_signal: The post describes worsening global outlook alongside continuing support for cooperation when it delivers security, aid, and solutions, with publics divided over U.S., Chinese, or coalition leadership.
linked_research_question: Why can global publics feel the world is worsening while still wanting cooperation that delivers security, aid, and results?
limits: The post is a secondary interpretation of a survey and does not expose the full questionnaire
Attitudes toward cooperation do not establish policy commitments
The author’s framing may emphasize actionable cooperation over non-cooperative views
